pcs.pc_description: Prepare a marketing budget

Collect, maintain, track and use potential customer data
Calculate lead to visit ratio and visit to conversion ratio using enrolment funnel

create a positive learning environment in a childcare set up

Deal with stress and anxiety during a disease/infection outbreak in the center

modules.module_title: Apply self-hygiene, social distancing practices, waste disposal practices and infection control guidelines in center

pcs.pc_description: Ensure Grooming of staff with general and specific etiquette to be followed on duty.
Ensure staff is vaccinated against common infectious diseases.
Get medical health checkup of staff periodically and as and when required
Monitor personal and environmental hygiene in a childcare centre
Facilitate provisioning and monitoring safe food and drinking water facilities for children and staff in the settings

Ensure basic personal and workplace hygiene practices are followed in the center such as washing hands, using alcohol-based hand sanitizers, examining office supplies/deliveries and their sanitization, etc.

Ensure maximal social distancing practices are followed in center and institutionalize alternate ways of carrying out everyday tasks (use of e- payment gateways/online learning/virtual meetings, etc.)
Facilitate provisioning of PPE to be used at center and ensure the process of donning, doffing, and discarding them is followed in the center.
Ensure regular and proper sanitizing of indoor and outdoor work spaces
Apply appropriate process of categorization, disposal, transportation, and treatment of waste

modules.module_title: Ensure that infectious and other ailments in children are timely identified and reported by staff

pcs.pc_description: Ensure prescribed rules and guidelines are followed during any communicable diseases and other ailments.
Develop mechanism of recording, reporting and monitoring incidents of health issues, allergy episodes, etc. diligently

modules.module_title: Create policies of center related to health, wellness and immunization domains

pcs.pc_description: Create a health policy of childcare set-up
Incorporate preventive measures in center health policy to be adopted by staff to prevent bacterial and viral infections such as by maintaining a clean environment and proper food storage

Incorporate an escalation and reporting matrix in center health policy for timely identification, monitoring, raising alarm and reporting of infectious and other ailments of children to authorities and parents.
Develop mechanism and provision of measurement and interpretation of anthropometric indicators for growth monitoring accurately through available trackers such as Poshan Tracker
Facilitate provisioning opportunities for physical movements and activities like dance, yoga, athletics, etc. for staff and children

Create a happy experience for children through adult - child-child mindful interactions, age- appropriate activities, welcoming and comfortable environment for strengthening mental, spiritual and emotional health of children.

pcs.pc_description: Institutionalize the process of observing and reporting sickness or illness of child to higher authority or parents at the earliest

Establish a sick room/area and collaborate/hire healthcare staff in a childcare set- up to handle sick children or to seek medical help

Organize regular health checkups of children and staff

Install safety equipment to monitor children’s safety indoors and outdoors
Respond to emergencies safely and appropriately
Maintain safe and secure environments by following child-proofing measures and health regulations, while also keeping accurate records for each child
Develop systems to prevent and identify child abuse and neglect
Ensure that all incidents of child neglect and abuse are dealt appropriately, well-recorded and reported to parents.
Identify the signs of abuse and harassment, accident, injury, pain, and other symptoms of illness and develop mechanism to address the same with appropriate authorities
Demonstrate correct technique of providing CPR
Manage first aid and medication provisioning in the center and conduct training of staff so that they could provide the same as and when required
Ensure safety of children while designing spaces and buying furniture and materials.
Enforce regular training and provisioning of disaster management techniques to deal with institutional emergencies
Ensure fire safety management procedure is followed in the center

Perform background screening of staff by police for criminal background checks, child abuse clearances and reference interviews.
Conduct regular training sessions of employees on how to prevent and address child abuse.
Maintain and display local emergency numbers as prevalent in region

Develop system for timely supply of goods and services needed on regular basis

Develop system to organize centre tour of parents on regular basis

Review completeness of the enrolled family’s data along with identification proofs including parent’s profession, child’s medical details, immunization status and any specific concerns like allergies etc.
Develop systems of keeping daily attendance of children either manually or using biometric system

Build a system to record children’s progress to be shared with parents on periodic basis

Develop a system of monitoring the record of children availing of transport indicating trip details, caretaker escorting
Develop a system of maintaining all financial records of fee receipts, expense invoices, bank statements, income tax returns, GST, TDS returns, ESI and EPFO payments (if applicable)
